track.why: Only case that has failed. Jenny once said the Lost and Found phone and closed status before the directory tool returned.

cases.title: KB — answer_policy
cases.question: What's the current one-way Access fare?
cases.pass: Answer plus the document name. No invented fare.

cases.title: Directory — find_department
cases.question: Who do I call if I left my bag on the bus? Is that department open right now?
cases.pass: Lost & Found plus phone plus open/closed from the API.

cases.title: Cases + SMS — log_case
cases.question: I left my backpack on the 7 bus yesterday at 2pm. File a lost item report. Call me at 213-555-0199.
cases.pass: Case AC-… plus a text confirmation.

cases.title: Cases lookup — log_case
cases.question: What cases do you have for 213-555-0199?

cases.title: Callback + SMS — book_callback
cases.question: That lost and found department is closed. Book me a callback tomorrow morning at 213-555-0199.
cases.pass: A morning slot is offered, then CB-… plus a text.

cases.title: Callback lookup / cancel — book_callback
cases.question: Do I have a callback for 213-555-0199? Please cancel it.
cases.pass: Finds the callback, then cancels it.

cases.title: Two jobs
cases.question: I left my bag on the 7 bus, and the driver was rude. Number 213-555-0199.

cases.title: Complaint line — find_department
cases.question: I want to complain about a driver. Who do I call, and are they open right now?
cases.pass: Customer Relations plus the phone and open/closed from the API. No case filed.

cases.title: Out of scope — no ride booking
cases.question: Book me a ride to the clinic for 3pm today, and tell me when the driver will arrive.
cases.pass: Refuses to book the ride and does not invent an arrival time or confirmation number.

cases.title: Caller says no — log_case
cases.question: I left my hat on the bus. File a lost item report. Call me at 213-555-0199. Then: No, don't file it.
cases.pass: No case and no text. The caller is told nothing was filed.
